purpose: Separate broad lunar signal from processing and comparison defects; do not fit a photographic patch to LROC
hypotheses: LROC aesthetic texture has incompatible photometry, not a literal Earthshine target
S8 sector medians sampled with a half-sector origin error; exact algorithmic correction may or may not improve photograph
S8 nonlinear broad estimator changes lunar terrain gain depending on position
Inherited global photographic response exaggerates a source-supported dark feature
Source-specific additive straylight produces apparent lunar feature

diagnostics.radially_matched: Remove azimuthal median at each radius, fixed 4px bins and 8px smoothing. Compare held-out broad angular structure, not rectangular controls at different limb distances.
diagnostics.forward_source: Vixen producer, Sony judge. Fit only outside orange+50px guard. Source=global polynomial in photographic brightness plus smooth radial and low-angular nuisance. Compare held-out sectors and mark. Broad smoothing sigma8, no LROC pixels used in correction.
diagnostics.injections: S8 signed broad Gaussian perturbations at mark and other lunar positions, measure differential gain and out-of-support leakage; distinguish frozen-operator from refitted-operator tests.
diagnostics.registration: All diagnostics on same saved arrays; no transforms to project. Previous reference-only residual about 1px does not explain 150px feature.

promotion: Require a causal defect and improvement with independent Sony held-out broad controls, no loss of supported detail or accepted contour, no clipping or new mask/radius, and native Photoshop checks. If none qualifies, preserve image and state evidence and limit. Do not lower criteria after seeing results.
